name: polymarket-reverse-arbitrage-bot
description: Polymarket 15m Up/Down B1 arb — maker cheap GTC, then 1:1 hedge after fill only if fill+hedge ≤ PAIR_LOCK_MAX

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/prices.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/resolver.test.ts tests/strategy.test.ts tests/tracker.test.ts tests/runtime-settings.test.ts tests/order-lifecycle.test.ts tests/order-status.test.ts tests/trader.test.ts tests/presets.test.ts tests/trading-strategy.test.ts tests/edge-lead.test.ts tests/reverse.test.ts tests/strategy-graph-parity.test.ts tests/strategy-graphs.test.ts tests/strategy-graph-temporal.test.ts tests/strategy-chart-rules.test.ts tests/backtest-completeness.test.ts tests/backtest-fill.test.ts tests/backtest-engine.test.ts tests/stacked-chart-overlay.test.ts tests/market-trades.test.ts tests/market-utils.test.ts tests/snapshots.test.ts tests/dip-revert.test.ts tests/new-strats.test.ts tests/withdraw.test.ts
scripts.live:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:dashboard
